tool: vendor/gtopen/crates/solver/examples/t2_cross_eval.rs: loads a saved preflop profile, holds it fixed, computes best-response gaps and EVs under the continuation tables named by T2_CONT_FILE; no iteration
validation: cross-eval of the F72 save under M14_72 must reproduce the F72 gaps and EVs exactly (same profile, same tables); else hard stop

games.bootstrap: the blended replicate tables of A4b (30 per panel); replicates marked guard_hard_stop are excluded

metric.loss: L(sigma; T) = gap_total(sigma; T) - gap_total(sigma_T; T), bb per hand summed over seats, where sigma_T is the profile solved under T (F72, F144, or the replicate's own solve); also per seat (SB, BB, BTN, CO)
metric.L_switch: L(sigma72; M14_144): what keeping the 72-flop policy costs if the 144-flop tables are right
metric.L_noise_144: 95th percentile over the 144-panel bootstrap tables of L(sigma144; T_rep)
metric.L_noise_72: 95th percentile over the 72-panel bootstrap tables of L(sigma72; T_rep)

classification_fixed_before_results.threshold_note: 0.005 bb/hand = 0.5 bb/100 hands; 0.02 = 2 bb/100. Provisional research thresholds, not the production-DB criterion (the user's)

after.NOT_ROBUST: report 288 (or a targeted alternative) as the next candidate with its cost, and wait; never started automatically
